title: LMCache/LMCache Release v0.5.3rc2 · CUDA 12.9
problem: CUDA 12.9 vLLM deployments need an LMCache package and resolver setup that selects the compatible PyTorch CUDA build for reproducible KV-cache infrastructure.
mechanism: The release publishes a CUDA 12.9 LMCache v0.5.3rc2 wheel and documents uv pip installation using PyTorch's cu129 extra index, the GitHub expanded-assets wheel location, and an unsafe-best-match index strategy.

evidence.claim: A CUDA 12.9 wheel is published for LMCache v0.5.3rc2.
The documented installation uses uv pip with the PyTorch cu129 extra index and LMCache expanded-assets link.

evaluation_context: This official LMCache GitHub release is a CUDA 12.9 packaging artifact. It specifies the wheel target and resolver command but provides no KV-cache transfer, serving latency, throughput, or network utilization measurements.
limitations: The release candidate does not prove compatibility with every CUDA 12.9 driver, PyTorch, vLLM, or GPU combination. The unsafe-best-match resolver can mix package indexes and needs validation in a pinned environment. The page contains GitHub loading-error placeholders around the short body.
project_relevance: This is an environment prerequisite for running LMCache KV-cache transfer experiments on CUDA 12.9, not evidence of TPN scheduling or network performance gains. Preserve exact CUDA/PyTorch/vLLM versions when comparing runs (inference).
source_notes: Facts extracted from the fetched official LMCache GitHub release page; title copied exactly from input metadata.
No performance claims were inferred from the packaging release.
